digest.component_or_area: development process audit evaluation and decision history reconciliation
propositions: Six process improvement proposals from the development-process audit must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor remediations, architecture decisions, and implementation tickets to determine reaffirm, refine, reconsider, or defer dispositions with explicit rationale.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by field) was partially implemented with fail-open, present-only capture at 1.1% coverage; refine by expanding automatic stamping at known filer/agent boundaries rather than requiring global or retrospective changes.

Deterministic plan preflight floor exists at P1-P11 with proven low false-positive rates from blocktesting; extend only for recurrent, mechanically decidable failure classes with offline replay validation and explicit false-positive ceilings.

Completion-failure classification has 351 durable FAIL sidecars with 682 structured findings; classify historical failures offline into code defect, unmet AC, missing test, plan gap, environment error, or verifier failure before adding schema rather than treating all non-PASS outcomes as escaped defects.

Risk-tiered review must account for the fact that this project has no routine human Gerrit review and operates as an autonomous process; pilot risk reporting without merge enforcement using prospective signals (security surfaces, complexity, plan-review history) and measure defects/reverts/override frequency before hard thresholds.

Maintainership breadth assessment must be reframed for autonomous governance; do not add mandatory human approval, but durably distinguish author from reviewer agent/model, monitor provider diversity and correlated failures, and test secondary recovery paths for critical infrastructure.
